Shows app functionality that requires user interaction.
Silent Boot mutes your phone on shutdown to keep it quiet on boot and tries to restore the previous ringer mode after startup is complete.

Silent Boot requires a service that can react to the event of your phone shutting down. Since Android is very restrictive about what apps can do while you are not directly interacting with them, this service must display a constant notification.

Starting with Android 17, Silent Boot can no longer restore the previous settings automatically after a reboot. Instead, it will display a notification that you have to tap manually to restore your settings.
